articles.summary: Howdy all, We’ve rolled out Webmin 2.641 and Usermin 2.540 to all Virtualmin repos. Changes since Webmin 2.640: Add support for trusted proxy IP addresses Fix a bug when editing monitors in the System and Server Status module Fix skip hwclock when unavailable #2693 Changes since Webmin 2.630 and Usermin 2.530: Add new nftables module with profiles, saved tables, and chains/sets management Add new Nginx module with look and feel matching the Apache module Add option to hide sensitive value...
articles.title: Webmin 2.641 and Usermin 2.540 released
